title: Fatality report praises RCMP who fatally shot Vegreville man
article: An Alberta fatality report says a Mountie had no choice when he fatally shot a drunken man with a shotgun who was threatening to commit "suicide by cop."
Leo Raymond Poulin, 59, was shot three times in the chest on July 12, 2008, after he refused repeated requests to drop the weapon in Vegreville, about 100 kilometres east of Edmonton.
The report says Poulin had no criminal record or a history of violence and RCMP could not have predicted his behaviour in advance.
The report says Poulin had mental problems and had been drinking heavily before he confronted the officers.
The judge made no recommendations in the report, which praises the Mounties for not retreating in the face of the threat.
Poulin's blood alcohol level at the time of his death was more than three times higher than the legal driving limit.
